text:
Noah Li: Thinking about a compact mode for the autoscale row on dashboards. Two options: a) collapse min/max into a single compact label with chevron to expand, b) use a dual-thumb control (min/max) inline. Sketch: https://www.figma.com/file/mini/compact-autoscale
Elena Torres: Dual-thumb looks sleek but might be confusing on mobile. If we go dual-thumb we need strong affordances for which thumb is active and clear labels.
Kai Zhang: Implementation concern: our current stepper component is separate for min/max. Dual-thumb would need a new control and extra testing. Maybe we ship collapsed label first, iterate to dual-thumb later.
Ben Wallace: Collapsed label idea: show `Min 1 — Max 8` with a small badge showing `Burst: On` or `Burst: Locked` and a chevron. Tap/Enter expands to steppers. Keeps layout stable.
Noah Li: Agreed. Accessibility notes: when collapsed, convey the state with `aria-expanded` on the chevron and a descriptive `aria-label` like `Autoscale: min 1, max 8, burst enabled, press enter to expand`.
a11y-robot: Reminder: for screen readers use `aria-live="polite"` on the region that shows estimates so users get updates when numbers change.
Elena Torres: Copy tweak for locked burst: prefer `Burst unavailable — pinned pool` over `Burst locked` (more explicit). Add a lock icon and text; don't rely on color.
Kai Zhang: Keyboard flow: Tab lands on collapsed row -> chevron (Enter opens) -> focus lands on min input -> shift+tab to previous -> max input -> burst toggle. Escape closes and returns focus to chevron.
Ben Wallace: Microcopy for the burst badge: short: `Burst (short)` with tooltip: `Uses spare capacity for X minutes; may affect pricing`. Tooltip should show est. delta: `+12% cost · p95 +40ms`.
Noah Li: UX: when user edits while collapsed (inline edit), validate immediately and surface guardrail feedback: `This exceeds SLO guardrail: p95 would be ~520ms` with action `Auto-suggest safe value`.
Elena Torres: Visual: ensure collapsed row touch targets remain >=44px, chevron hits, and separator between min/max uses 1px high-contrast stroke. Also add visible focus ring on chevron for keyboard users.
a11y-robot: Also ensure live region updates are debounced (200ms) to avoid screen reader spam when scrubbing sliders.
Kai Zhang: Implementation plan: ship collapsed/expanded with accessible labels this sprint. Dual-thumb as follow-up if we get designer signoff and PM wants it. I'll open a tech task for the stepper accessibility changes.
